description.info: Joined after graduation as a nuclear engineer. Met a lot of smart people - too many smart people. Met a lot of local people - too many local people.
Time to get my nature on. Gonna climb a mountain.

Got a lot of money to work with a bunch of AR headsets, like the Google Glass, RealWear HMT-1, and other VR tools. Bought a bunch of other radiation detection equipment to make an automated radiation detecting roomba.
Did lots of fun data science. Learned a whole bunch of machine learning techniques and tools. Visit my GitHub to learn more about data analysis!
Phew. That was a long internship. Fun and vibrant place to work. Smart people, smart attitudes, and lots of smiles.
Got to experience the nuclear industry for the first time. It was nice. Fixed a lot of the things.
This was, literally, a 24/7 hackathon, half of the people were sleeping and half was coding. My team ended up being a winner, we presented to a bunch of investors, and technology start-ups.
